# Archived Tasks

> Completed task entries archived from `.github/ai/tasks.md`.

## Archive Policy

When a milestone is completed, preserve its task IDs, title/status records, and acceptance notes in
this archive. The active `tasks.md` contains only the current milestone and may retain no completed
milestone section after the locked Orchestrator archive transaction.

- Order: newest milestone first (by closing time). Insert new sections immediately below the insert-point marker, never at the end.
